mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.2% indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.2% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: Low housing starts (HOUST) below 550 thousand units signal weak residential construction, indicating a slowing economy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST < 550 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 9.5%) combined with very low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) signals a severe economic downturn, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered periods (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: In the post-recession recovery phase, rising employment (PAYEMS) indicates improving labor market conditions, supporting corporate hiring and earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of the post-recession recovery period (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: High retail sales (RSAFS) above 350,000 million dollars indicate strong consumer spending, boosting corporate revenues and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS > 350000 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: A rising federal funds rate above 0.5% signals monetary tightening, increasing discount rates for equities and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.5 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: Falling industrial production (INDPRO < 100) combined with rising unemployment (UNRATE > 9.0%) signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered periods (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: In the early-cycle expansion phase, rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strengthening manufacturing activity, supporting corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of the early-cycle expansion period (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).
